card.title: MOMENTUM
card.text: Add two PANZER I-B to the frontline if it is not enemy controlled.
card.flavorText: During the early stages of WWII, Germany experienced significant military momentum, achieving several swift and decisive victories on the European continent. In 1939, Germany invaded Poland, prompting Britain and France to declare war. In 1940, Germany launched a series of lightning offensives, conquering Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, Belgium, and France in just a few months. Of course losing the Battle of Britain was a major blowback for the German war machine, but up until that moment they seemed to be invincible and their tactics were characterized by speed, surprise, and a devastating combination of tanks, infantry, and air power. However, Germany's early successes would ultimately be unsustainable as they faced increasing resistance from allied forces and were eventually defeated.
